notes.title: Updated Animation and flow
notes.content:
A quick couple of things.. 
   -After realising a handful of animation errors i had in the last build, i changed a few settings and got them alot more efficient. For example, window jump animations and getting turned into a zombie/skeleton. 
   -I had some bullet collision errors
   - The Chest will respawn 60 seconds after being open.
   - The Characters respawning is much more accurate. 
   - And many more simple things... 

I plan on updating more as soon as possible! Hit me up with suggestions and recomendations!!

notes.title: A better look at the finish line :D
notes.content:
Many, many updates to speak of i dont know where to start.
- New Skeletons with IK handles for Human based characters.
- New Characters Zombies/ Demons / Ghosts/ Skeletons / Bandits/ Villagers/ Hunters/ Hosts. 
- Zombies are basic and can infect Human Characters with a bite(NPC/PLayer)
- Skeletons are basic and can infect Human characters with a bite(NPC/PLayer)
- Demons are stronger and faster then humans with an added psychic push demon wave ability. 
- Alpha Demons are even stronger with super jump and speed. Honestly they need a nerfing ;)
- Ghosts are the final form in an online match, When a player dies you'll become a ghost that can still somewhat interact with the physical world. Chat and stay part of your party.. but your glowing aura will be a target seen for miles.
- Bandits are the unfriendly Human groups you can find littering the area. They will likely try to rob you...after the fact. 
- Villagers are the friendly Human characters you can find around the realm, If you kill a good villager, the rest will not lke you anymore!
- New Hunters 11 to be exact. They have all the abilities as before, an upgraded weapon array, an Updated Magic set, with a special chalk that can write magic runes onto the floor that is a perfect trap if set it the right place. 
- Hosts arnt really new, just the old mannequin character with an updated purpose. A host- possesed by an evil spirit.
- Started Implementing Missions at least for chapter 1 and Intro outro video sequences for all the maps, cant wait till that is finished.
-Made one larger map (GrimmShackGully) to test alot of new traps and online capabilities. What works well where and why kind of stuff...
-Started the last two game modes: Protect the Town / Rival Villages
    Protect the town starts with upto 5 online team mates who'll have to protect the innocent villagers for the time limit as hordes of creatures decend upon them and their cabin
    Rival Villages Is more open world where characters will given a choice of Creature/ Human/ Undead/ etc. to either cause havoc or save their world from it
- New Ai for all the Characters and modes listed above.

Now that i realise I can build all of this and some of it is still rough around the edges I can Focus and improve the Parts where it needs it. Dreadful Shadows was alot to handle as an Indie Game Dev, I learnt an increadible amount, and i can wait to see what comes next. Comment and join me where ever you can, and stay awesome!

notes.title: V 1.022 Available. Started adding Voice Talent, Story and other fun stuff!! :D
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!! V1.022 Available
I have spent a great deal of time lately learning the sequencer abilities of Unreal Engine and have started developing a better story of sorts. To flush out the Realm and Lore a little bit more, I have decided to organically implement new characters as the story progresses with talented voice actors, while maintaining a better flow and look with the visual. Tell me what you think?!?!

For this update I have added new Traps and Features I have gotten from the currently unseen Manor 
Level, especially the "Trap Door" mechanic. A rough tutorial level has been made as well as a players hub/ hunting ground levels have been stated as I ramp everything up I hope to make a full update of progress and progression every Sunday from here on out until I am happy with the progress of where I am, and have a bit of a team made up, as I look to the future!!!    :)

[b]The Hunt game mode:[/b] where players can form teams with friends of 2-4 Hunters as they go out and Hunt in the forests / mountains / marshes / castles and the sort. Creatures will have a nest (which is the main spawn point) protected by a leader/ guardian that is stronger then the pack. Destroying The Nest is the best option for nearby villages, but as everything,  the higher the risk the higher the reward!!
[b]
Customizable Characters:[/b] players can receive rewards (ie:  new dance moves/ customized clothing / Items/ weapons and more), thus; having the ability to fully display yourself in the world of Dreadful Shadows. This Is where I would like to add that the current players who have already purchased the game will receive a reward of either. 
1. A New Skin: Van Hellskin - Fire cloak and hat skin made to look menacing as it stands out in the shadows. 
2 A New Character magic ability that is not game breaking. Something like a magic shout with push back.
3 . A Custom Weapon that the player will never lose and can reuse to their hearts content.
4. A Custom Monster Skin the for the players who joined first!! 

Let me know what you want to see first as I plan to implement most of this going forward!! Let Me know what you want to see next and have a say by contacting me:
on our Website      brainrootstudios.com/
or Discord          BrainRootStudio#9242

I will respond as fast as I can and hope to hear from you. Thanks in advance and have fun!!!

BrainRootStudio President
Adam Coward
